paragraphs: Rav Giddel bar Minyomi: Pesachim 107a. In the name of Rabbi Ammi: Shekalim, chapter 4. Before Rav Huna, Rabbi Chiyya bar Rav, and Rav Chilkiyah bar Tuvyah: Bava Batra 39b and the Jerusalem Talmud there. He stood before Rav Nachman: Berakhot 49, end of side a.
